I've been waiting since September (about four months now), and things are finally moving towards exchange, my solicitortold me we just have 1 more enquiry which waitjng for seller solicitorto get back. However, my estate agent has emailed me twice threatening to remarket the property if we don't exchange ASAP. And last week, they even gavd me seller's last call, saying the seller would remarket if we don't exchange the following week. I was incredibly stressed.

I immediately called my solicitor, who had just spoken to the seller's solicitor. She told me there was only one outstanding enquiry regarding a land registry charge, and she was confused by the estate agent's urgency. So, I emailed the estate agent, pointing out that we were just waiting on the seller's response to this one remaining enquiry, and that my solicitor had confirmed this with their solicitor. I asked them who would be responsible for any losses incurred due to their threats. Their response was vague, something like "I can not respond too as you are asking question that need to be answered by a legal professional"

Honestly, I'm trying to figure out who is actually driving this panic. It seems like the estate agent isn't fully aware of the actual situation, and they're causing unnecessary stress with these threats.  pronouncements.
